sentences.japanese: 公平に評すれば、彼はいい奴だ。
sentences.english: To do him justice, he is a nice guy.

sentences.japanese: 彼はその男を典型的な紳士と評した。
sentences.english: He described the man as a model gentleman.

sentences.japanese: 公平に評すれば、彼は善意からやったのだと認めなければならない。
sentences.english: To do him justice, we must admit that his intentions were good.

sentences.japanese: 公平に評すれば、彼は信頼できる男だ。
sentences.english: To do him justice, he is a reliable man.

sentences.japanese: 公平に評すれば、彼は最善を尽くした。
sentences.english: In all fairness, he did do his best.
